scope: Exploratory fonts only. Same text, geometry, size policy and cached art within each card. Frame-only transform held fixed across candidates; rejected fits use identity and remain diagnostic. No shared calibration changed. Diagnostic F1 permits local translation only, never size/skew.
selection: 15 frame/symbol review cards plus Air Elemental, Animate Wall, Ankh of Mishra and Armageddon in LEA and 3ED. Exploratory, not a corpus acceptance study; several scans have wording differences.
fontMatching: Same font size policy, margins, leading, frame, art, text and scan transform within each comparison. Header faces cover weights 400–700 to avoid synthetic bold. No candidate-specific scale or skew. Body trial replaces upright rules only; existing italics remain fixed.

decision.adopt: Matrix Bold for the optional Eighth Edition base plate.
decision.retain: Current MPlantin and Beleren defaults. Do not globally promote Plantin Semibold or MSE MPlantin on these mixed results.
decision.review: Two 2003-frame titles pass frame-only registration. Other header/body values with rejected normalization are diagnostics, not calibrated acceptance scores. Early core-set symbol rarity treatments, plate geometry, footer/artist sizing and modern crowns/pinlines still require review.
